name: GVMS — get a Goods Movement Record

comment: Echoes back whatever GMR id was asked for and reports it OPEN — the happy path.
To rehearse a rejection, copy this file, set metadata.state to NOT_FINALISABLE
and add a ruleFailures array, then give it a higher priority and a request
matcher narrow enough to pick out the id you want to fail.
The `now` helper takes no explicit format= here on purpose — see 'WireMock
response templates cannot contain escaped double quotes' in iac/README.md
Known issues. This mapping 500'd on every real request until that was found;
bare `{{now}}`/`{{now offset='...'}}` already renders full ISO-8601 with
seconds precision, which is what was being reconstructed by hand before.
